Package model

Class Dealer

java.lang.Object
java.util.Observable
model.Player
model.Dealer
public class Dealer extends Player
Singleton class representing the dealer in the game.

Extends Player and manages the deck, dealing cards, applying rules (American or European), and interacting with players' hands.
